task: Fix email notification retry behavior so transient SMTP errors retry and permanent SMTP errors do not.

messages.content: I will inspect the failing retry-policy tests and the centralized retry policy.
Tests expect email SMTP_TEMP to retry and SMTP_PERM to stop.
Retry policy is centralized in src/retryPolicy.js.
Updated src/retryPolicy.js to retry SMTP_TEMP and not retry SMTP_PERM, then ran tests.
